title: DemandForecast
description: Output schema for Module 2 (Demand Intelligence) predicting future legitimate API workload demand.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this forecast event.

trace_id.description: Distributed tracing identifier associated with this forecast.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of this JSON Schema contract.

service_version.description: Version of the Demand Intelligence service that produced this forecast.

model_version.description: Identifier/version of the demand forecasting model (e.g. demand-v0, demand-prophet-v1).

forecast_horizon_seconds.description: Forecasting time horizon forward into the future, in seconds.

predicted_legitimate_rps.description: Point estimate of future legitimate requests per second.

lower_bound_rps.description: Lower confidence interval bound for legitimate requests per second.

upper_bound_rps.description: Upper confidence interval bound for legitimate requests per second.
